summary.text: Jack Bader is the Democratic candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 97, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Republican Briar Bearss in a race without an incumbent.

paragraphs.text: Bader earned a high school diploma from Vassar High School and attended Delta College, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working as a realtor.
Bader won the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026, defeating Kandie Sherman, 56.4 percent to 43.6 percent.
